metadata.title: Clicked like I lost my mouse and somehow locked down 5 kills?! Valorant’s aim is on vacation
metadata.description:
Me: panic clicking like a caffeinated squirrel
Enemies: probably uninstalling in confusion
How did I even get all 5? No clue, but I’m cashing in
Click if your aim ever ghosts you but still clutches!

Tap if your panic clicks ever surprise even YOU!
